rq_title: Can property-directed sequence planning produce intended candidate paths?
primary_metrics: candidate-path retention; Property/Value/Repeat/Top-K behavior on controlled benchmarks
supported_claim: The V1 components address their declared controlled obstacles and produce auditable candidate paths.
limitations: Designed small benchmarks; no real-ecosystem generalization or end-to-end speedup.

rq_title: Can the generated Harness execute public property benchmarks reliably under the declared wrapper model?
primary_metrics: artifact completeness; checksum pass; parser/status agreement; status counts
supported_claim: The four preregistered supported tasks produced a complete and auditable 120-run result set under the declared wrapper model.
limitations: B2 was static-only; Harness is not Original-equivalent; completeness does not prove safety.

rq_title: How do Original, Full-K1, and Full-K5 compare descriptively on the preregistered supported public tasks?
primary_metrics: runs; falsified; budget_exhausted; observed falsification rate by task and method
supported_claim: The three methods can be compared descriptively on the four supported tasks and seeds 1-10.
limitations: No significance or superiority claim; no Total-calls speedup; budget observations are not passes.

rq_title: What semantic boundaries limit the interpretation of Harness results?
primary_metrics: caller model; transaction atomicity; rollback scope; value/time/external-call dependencies; supported/conditional classification
supported_claim: Harness outcomes must be interpreted under a wrapper model and caller-sensitive tasks must remain conditional.
limitations: B2 static_gate_only is not complete native replay; fixed-path consistency is not search-process equivalence.
